content:
jamie-oncall: getting alerts — controller-manager in eu-west1 is in a crashloop since ~09:02 UTC, apiserver error 503s rising, etcd compactor job spiked IO at 09:00 and leader moved twice. GPU pool attach failures are piling up. anyone seeing the same?

rory: saw the same. kube-scheduler started backoff on a bunch of gpu-node pods. failure paths look like apiserver timeouts to controllers.

meera: digging into metrics — etcddisk_iops spiked from 20k -> 95k for ~40s, compaction latency went to >2s, raft leader changed at 09:01:12 and 09:02:05. logs show WAL fsync stalls.

infra-bot: [09:03:25] incident: eu-west1 control-plane health degraded. PagerDuty: paged jamie-oncall, meera.

jamie-oncall: paste of kubectl logs (controller-manager):
```
E0309 09:02:22.123456 1 leaderelection.go:325] error retrieving resource lock: context deadline exceeded
I0309 09:02:25.234567 1 leaderelection.go:242] failed to renew lease: etcdserver: request timed out
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

laura: noticing provisioning queue grows — dedicated GPU attach requests are stuck waiting for node ejection. This will start billing at burst rates if we failover to warm pools. We should avoid a whole-region burst.

rory: can we throttle the autoscaler or pause new pool attaches in eu-west1 temporarily? we can route new requests to eu-central as fallback for a bit.

meera: agree. patch to disable autoscaler attach cron is ready. I'll apply canary to eu-west1 and leave EU fallback routing for 10m.

tom: quick check — etcd pod on leader node is `etcd-3`. kernel dmesg shows IO scheduler queuing. storage team said they saw a short maintenance at 09:00 that increased latency on nvme. I'll loop them in.

jamie-oncall: action list: 1) meera apply autoscaler pause (in 2m) 2) laura flip routing to eu-central fallback 3) rory stand by to scale down warm pool to avoid burst billing 4) tom file storage ticket with nvme logs and request IO relief 5) if leader doesn't stabilize in 10m, promote snapshot restore to standby cluster (we don't want that yet).

meera: pausing attach job now: `kubectl patch cm gpu-autoscaler-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"attach_enabled":"false"}}'` — applied to eu-west1 canary.

laura: switching routing: set api-routing override -> eu-central fallback. patch pushed to routing service, traffic drained from eu-west1 attach controller.

rory: scaling warm pool down by 30% to avoid committing budget — rolling now. monitoring cost alerts muted for this window.

tom: storage ticket #ST-4728 filed with logs and nvme SMART snapshots attached. storage ops acknowledged and are investigating a transient microcode job.

jamie-oncall: short-term metrics after changes: apiserver 503s down 60% in 3m, controller-manager restart rate still elevated but leader stable on etcd-2 now. keeping watch. please post any further odd logs. :thumbsup:

meera: still seeing occasional etcd rpc timeouts ~09:10 but far fewer. will keep the autoscaler paused until we confirm sustained stability.

laura: cost note — if warm pool stays scaled down >30m we may hit SLA on cold attach latency for some customers; cc @product for heads-up.

jamie-oncall: thanks all. follow-ups: tom to update storage ticket with mitigation ETA, meera to revert autoscaler after 30m of stable control plane, laura to prepare customer comms if warm pool reduction extends.

infra-bot: [09:24:35] update: eu-west1 storage ops reported microcode job completed at 09:15, nvme latency back to normal."
